Heba Al-Wasity’s debut gothic fantasy, Weavingshaw, is the first in a trilogy following Leena Al-Sayer, a young woman who wakes one day with the ability to see ghosts. When her brother becomes gravely ill, Leena barters this secret to the Saint of Silence, a dark purveyor of secrets whose business thrives on the covert confessions […]
